paragraphs: Many families in Ireland get help from the State to pay rent. This help is called HAP. But it is very hard to find a home with HAP.
The charity Simon Communities looked at homes to rent in 16 places in September. It found 1,361 homes. Only 12 of them had a rent low enough for HAP.
Eleven places had no homes for HAP at all. These include Cork, Galway, Limerick and Waterford. Seven of the 12 homes were in Dublin.
Ber Grogan works for the charity. She says rents went up a lot in ten years. But HAP did not change much. She wants the Government to raise the HAP limits now.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭很多家庭從國家得到付房租的幫助。
這種幫助叫做HAP（住房補助金）。
但是用HAP很難找到房子。
慈善機構西蒙社區在九月查看了16個地方的出租房。
它找到了1,361間房子。
其中只有12間的房租低到可以用HAP。
有11個地方完全沒有適合HAP的房子。
這些地方包括科克、高威、利默里克和沃特福德。
12間房子中有7間在都柏林。
貝爾·格羅根在這個慈善機構工作。
她說房租在十年內漲了很多。
但HAP沒有什麼改變。
她希望政府現在就提高HAP的上限。

paragraphs: Only 12 homes for rent were within the limits of the Housing Assistance Payment (HAP) in September, a new report from the Simon Communities of Ireland says. HAP is State help that pays part of the rent for people on low incomes.
The charity checked 16 areas on three days in September. It found 1,361 homes to rent at any price. That is 63% more than a year earlier. But very few were cheap enough for HAP.

In 11 of the 16 areas, there were no homes at all within HAP limits. These areas include Athlone, Cork, Galway, Limerick, Sligo and Waterford. Seven of the 12 homes were in Dublin. Outside Dublin, only Dundalk and Kildare had any.
Ber Grogan, the head of Simon Communities, said rents had gone up a lot over ten years, but HAP had hardly changed. She was disappointed that Budget 2027 did not raise the limits.
She said people who use HAP are more and more locked out of the rental market. The charity wants the Government to increase HAP limits now.

這個慈善機構在九月的三天裡調查了16個地區。
它找到1,361間各種價位的出租房。
這比一年前多了63%。
但很少有便宜到能用HAP的。
16個地區中有11個完全沒有在HAP上限內的房子。
這些地區包括阿斯隆、科克、高威、利默里克、斯萊戈和沃特福德。
12間房子中有7間在都柏林。
在都柏林以外，只有鄧多克和基爾代爾有。

paragraphs: Just 12 rental properties across 16 areas of Ireland were available within Housing Assistance Payment (HAP) limits in September, according to the latest Locked Out of the Market report from the Simon Communities of Ireland.

HAP is a State support that helps low-income households pay rent to private landlords. The charity surveyed listings on three dates and found 1,361 properties to rent at any price, an increase of 63% compared with September 2025.

However, 11 of the 16 areas, including Athlone, Cork, Galway, Limerick, Sligo and Waterford city, had no HAP-eligible homes whatsoever. Seven of the 12 properties were in Dublin, while outside the capital only Dundalk and Kildare had any.

Ber Grogan, executive director of Simon Communities, said rents had risen dramatically over the past decade while HAP had seen little change. She criticised Budget 2027 for failing to increase the limits.
She warned that people relying on HAP were increasingly locked out of the private rental market, and urged the Government to raise the limits as an urgent and practical measure.
sentZh: 根據愛爾蘭西蒙社區最新的《被擋在市場之外》報告，九月愛爾蘭16個地區只有12間出租房在住房補助金（HAP）的上限內。
HAP是幫助低收入家庭向私人房東支付房租的國家補助。
該慈善機構在三個日期調查了出租廣告，找到1,361間各種價位的出租房，比2025年九月增加63%。
然而，16個地區中有11個，包括阿斯隆、科克、高威、利默里克、斯萊戈和沃特福德市，完全沒有符合HAP資格的房子。
12間房子中有7間在都柏林，首都以外只有鄧多克和基爾代爾有。
西蒙社區執行長貝爾·格羅根說，過去十年房租大幅上漲，而HAP幾乎沒有變化。
她批評2027年度預算沒有提高上限。
她警告，依賴HAP的人越來越被擋在私人租屋市場之外，並敦促政府把提高上限當作緊急又實際的措施。

paragraphs: A mere 12 rental properties in 16 areas fell within Housing Assistance Payment (HAP) thresholds in September, the latest Locked Out of the Market report by the Simon Communities of Ireland reveals.

HAP is a State subsidy that enables low-income households to rent from private landlords. Scouring listings on three separate dates, the charity identified 1,361 properties available at any price, a hefty 63% jump on the same month last year.

Nevertheless, 11 of the 16 areas, among them Athlone, Cork, Galway, Limerick, Sligo and Waterford, yielded not a single HAP-eligible home. Dublin accounted for seven of the dozen, while beyond the capital only Dundalk and Kildare registered any at all.
